correctness.rationale: Trace n-2 barrier for odd relative permutations, dual Schatten-Holder with rank-(n-1) partial isometry, and exact transposition barycenter prove the norm formula at every index including endpoints. Simplex affine independence follows from unique offdiagonal entries. Strict convexity at 1<p<infinity yields unique nearest points and exact farthest set. An exhaustive finite checker and independent small constrained optimizations corroborated the formulas without being used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: A sharp natural metric invariant of parity-restricted assignment polytopes in every dimension and Schatten norm: the loss after removing exactly half of the vertices is constant at p=1 but tends to zero for every p>1, and each deleted vertex projects onto a simplex face of dimension binomial(n,2)-1. This exact norm-sensitive approximation geometry is meaningful for parity-constrained matrix relaxations and is not an arbitrary low-order slice.
